Package gui

Class ReportsController

java.lang.Object
gui.ReportsController
public class ReportsController extends Object
FXML controller for the reports dashboard (ReportsFrame.fxml).

three tabs: visitor bar chart, cancellation table, and hourly-usage line chart. a shared period selector (month + year) at the top controls which calendar month is shown. park managers are locked to their park; dept. managers see all.

    • setupCancelTable

      private void setupCancelTable()
      wires cell-value factories for the cancellation table. status cells are colour-coded so CANCELLED vs NO_SHOW is obvious at a glance.

    • loadParksIntoFilters

      private void loadParksIntoFilters()
      loads parks and populates both filter combos. park managers get a single locked entry; dept. managers get all parks plus an "All Parks" sentinel.

    • handleRefreshVisitor

      public void handleRefreshVisitor(javafx.event.ActionEvent e)
      Parameters:
      e - the button-click event

    • loadVisitorReport

      private void loadVisitorReport()
      loads visitor report data for the selected month and populates the bar chart. INDIVIDUAL and SUBSCRIBER types are merged into one series so the chart stays readable.

    • handleRefreshCancel

      public void handleRefreshCancel(javafx.event.ActionEvent e)
      Parameters:
      e - the button-click event

    • loadCancelReport

      private void loadCancelReport()
      loads cancellation report data for the selected month and populates the table, then loads and renders the day-of-week distribution chart for the same filter. shows cancelled vs no-show counts separately in the status label.

    • loadCancelDistribution

      private void loadCancelDistribution(int parkFilter, String period)
      loads the cancellation day-of-week distribution for the same park filter and period as the cancellation table, and renders it as a bar chart (one bar per weekday, Sunday-first). the per-weekday average and per-active-day average are shown in the status label; the average bar height is highlighted via the label as a reference value.
      Parameters:
      parkFilter - the park ID, or 0 for the whole region
      period - human-readable period label such as "June 2026"

    • handleRefreshUsage

      public void handleRefreshUsage(javafx.event.ActionEvent e)
      Parameters:
      e - the button-click event

    • loadUsageReport

      private void loadUsageReport()
      loads usage report data for the selected month and plots one line-chart series per park. each point is (hourSlot, pct-of-capacity), capped at 100%.

    • handleRefreshDuration

      public void handleRefreshDuration(javafx.event.ActionEvent e)
      Parameters:
      e - the button-click event

    • loadDurationReport

      private void loadDurationReport()
      loads the average-visit-duration data for the selected month and plots one bar per visitor type (Individual, Group). each bar's height is the mean length of stay in hours for completed visits (those with both an entry and an exit recorded).
